quest.title: The Meaning of Courage
quest.description: With hearts as one, you and Varesa set out to investigate the true identity and intentions of the Sage-Lord of Fungi.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Return and inform people in the tribe

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Chief Acatl gathers people from the tribe to hear Varesa's report on the mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so it felt pretty normal in the moment, but hearing it back does sound kind of... ridiculous.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This silence speaks volumes...

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: So, the mushrooms in the orchard are sentient? What a remarkable discovery!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yeah, without your investigation, who knows what could have happened?

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Thanks for looking into it, and for collecting all this information!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Phew, what a relief... I was worried it sounded like I lost my marbles...

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it does sound far-fetched. After all, none of us have ever spoken to a mushroom.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: But, we know you're not one to lie, Varesa. Besides, the origin of the green mushrooms has always been a mystery to us.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, we now know something sinister could be going on. So, we should do our part to help!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yeah, just let me know if there's anything I can do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that didn't take much convincing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Oh, wait, you said the mushrooms need to be cooked on high heat, right? I can do that for you right now — I'll be quick.

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm back! I used cast iron, so it should be hot enough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it smells delicious! Suddenly, Paimon's hungry again!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: W—Well, here goes nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, that's his voice!

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
dialogues.text: Hahaha, looks like you stumbled upon the right path, but this temperature does not demonstrate even a fraction of the sincerity I require.

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
dialogues.text: Did you really think some common stove could generate enough heat to earn the acknowledgement of the Sage-Lord?

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
dialogues.text: Humans are such a disappointment. You can solve my riddles when the answers are handed to you on a silver platter...

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
dialogues.text: But, as soon as there are no more hints... not a shred of intelligence in sight.

dialogues.speaker: Sage-Lord of Fungi
dialogues.text: Do try and use your brain this time, hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Atolli
dialogues.text: H—How did it go? Did you hear the voice?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh! Annoying menace of a mushroom!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Sage-Lord of Fungi said the heat's still not high enough. Hmph, Sage-Lord of nitpicking, more like!

choices.text: Still, the only way to figure out his goal...

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Not high enough, huh... I guess that means we need a more powerful source of heat.

response.speaker: Acatl
response.text: Attention, everyone! We need items that can generate intense heat. Anything you can find!

response.speaker: Atolli
response.text: I'll see what I can do.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Leave it to me!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: We should take a look, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Definitely! We're not super familiar with this area, though. Do you have any ideas?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hmm... Nothing concrete, but we could check around the volcano.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It spews out all kinds of stuff. Maybe there's something we can use.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Awesome, let's go! Paimon's gonna find something scorching hot and then throw it at that stupid mushroom's face!

talks.objective: Look for the high-temperature materials needed

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Hey, there should be some Avatars of Lava somewhere along this path...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Their cores are really hot. It might be just what we need.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, when you think about how everyone jumped to help us like that, it seems like your tribe has been suspicious of the green mushrooms for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, but without you, we would have never gotten this far. I mean, tons of people have tried that mushroom without a weird voice talking in their head.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right... So, even if you wanted to investigate, you had nowhere to start...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, this opportunity was a long time coming! Plus, the Sage-Lord's arrogant attitude definitely triggered my tribe's competitive spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, competitions seem to be a thing here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm... Varesa doesn't seem competitive most of the time, though. Outside of training and fighting monsters, at least...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Yeah, well... I don't really like fighting or competing, to be honest. Simple day-to-day happiness is what matters to me.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Still, I've learned a lot from Coach Iansan. She taught me that strength is a means rather than an end.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: We get stronger so we can use our strength when it counts — like during the Abyss invasion. Having the training to master my Vision meant that I could do something to stop it.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: So, no matter how scared I feel, I know I have to be brave, because people are counting on me.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thanks. It's a work in progress. I can only hope that, one day, I can be as brave as Lady Fietena.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Alright, we should keep looking.

choices.text: There's a certain strength deep within you.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Done and dusted! This core should be perfect. Look! The phlogiston inside it is still active!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, let's see... Whoa, hot!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: A few more chunks like this, and we should be good. C'mon, let's keep heading up.

talks.objective: Talk to Varesa and obtain the material

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a great haul! A bunch of Seeing Eyes and this thing the weasel used to spew out fire!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I think that's its back armor! It shoots out phlogiston, so it can pretty much attack from all directions.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: My dad told me about them once — creatures that live in the volcano. I can't believe we actually ran into one!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: This piece of armor might produce even higher temperatures than the Seeing Eyes. Hehe, we'll get those mushrooms super hot this time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nice fighting back there, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, well... Even though I don't like fighting, sometimes, you don't have a choice. So, I've tried to figure out a bunch of different ways to get myself in the zone.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: For example, I've read a lot of stories about heroes, and my favorite hero has always been Fietena — the one I mentioned before.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Fietena's most iconic feature was her mask, so I decided to make one just like hers.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: So, now, whenever I wear the mask, it's like there's a little piece of her with me. If I want to honor her legacy, I have no choice but to be brave.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: At the same time, though... I guess it's kind of like a crutch. Kind of like, I'm hiding behind her strength.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you really think so?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Really? It's just...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I feel like... I need to take it off one day and face things alone.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: But, the longer I put off taking that step, the more impossible it feels. I... don't know if I have it in me.

choices.text: But you were the one who decided to investigate this case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, YOU had the courage to make that decision, and that's what adventuring is all about! Fighting is just a small part of it.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, Paimon thinks you're doing a great job! Just take your time — it's not a race.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Thanks for believing in me, you two. I've learned so much!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: And, I won't give up, not until I can face things on my own!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Phew, after that pep talk, I feel like my appetite is back in full force!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're hungry already? Paimon hasn't even finished digesting her last meal!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: C'mon, let's head back to the tribe. We'll earn that mushroom's recognition this time, for sure!

choices.text: It's nothing to feel ashamed about.
